scope: Read-only local dependency and execution-plan crosswalk. It does not accept any RC item, run a benchmark, or authorize implementation.
disposition_rule: Each requirement has exactly one disposition enum. Planning edges are scheduling aids, not replacement acceptance evidence or a waiver.

benchmark_gate.rule: RC51 may review only after every listed pre-benchmark requirement and pre-benchmark external obligation has accepted current-RC evidence; RC52 is post-gate.

stages.purpose: canonical source map, research disposition and readiness evidence
one executable/library, automatic discovery, historical frames and paid representation
selection, streaming, CLI, scheduling, resource, performance and hardware contracts
library API, streaming API, full-engine protocol, packages, standard formats and dictionaries
host SDK adapters, bindings, filesystem work, registries and actual platform runners
distribution, licensing, analyzers, robustness and reproducible optimized builds
only after restored native engine: one predeclared, small, exact source-plus-fixture screen for candidates still marked eligible; no corpus campaign or broad tournament
only the later frozen single pass
reporting/publication backlog retained under explicit user hold
